description: Charming 1930s home on a prime Central Sunset block. An ornate fireplace provides the living room with a nice refined feel. Beautiful hardwood floors cover most of both levels. The elegant formal dining room is situated near the bright kitchen. Two spacious bedrooms on the main level overlook the deep  &  inviting backyard. A sweeping ocean view is enjoyed from the rear bedroom. Even the closet offers a unique northern view. Downstairs features a third bedroom and half bath. Plenty of space for parking, storage, and further expansion potential is found in the garage. Don't miss your chance

While the property is ready for updating, it presents an outstanding opportunity for investors, flippers, or buyers looking to build instant equity with some cosmetic improvements.  The spacious backyard offers endless possibilities, with ample room for an ADU (buyer to verify), entertaining, gardening, or creating your own private outdoor retreat.
